title: Recording media acceptance
description: What ./scripts/recording-integration.sh --phase=media emits after ffprobe, and what tests/recording_integration.rs checks. Every field is measured from the produced file or from the run that produced it; nothing here is copied from configuration.

recording_id.description: The row this file belongs to, so a failed run names something an operator can look up.

expected_duration_seconds.description: How long the run says the room was up for. The duration is compared against this rather than against a constant, so a run cut short fails on its own terms; it is what the operator configured for the run, not something read back from the provider.

candidate_video_seconds.description: How long the candidate's camera was on screen in the template, measured by the template rather than inferred from the file: an MP4 of a composited page cannot say whose face was in it.

audio_tracks.description: Distinct audio sources heard in the room, the candidate and the interviewer.

avatar_rendered.description: Whether the template's own VRM render was running. False until a model is published, which is what makes this acceptance blocked on the avatar work rather than on this pipeline.
